nodes.label: Fault F35.1 — (b1) refused on size and the design changed after the result
Seam remainder as the total relaxation difference between paths
nodes.rationale: The exchange piece alone relaxes by ~0.1 Ha and is cancelled by kinetic+Hartree relaxation (virial), so the seam remainder must be relax_E - relax_O, the total relaxation difference between the two paths, not the exchange piece of one. The redesign is flagged as post-result and the new clause PB2-5 carries reduced weight under R 1449.
